name: Eve Keres
source:
Eve is friendly to a fault, and eager to help any lost souls that they may happen to come across. They're also a bit of a gossip, and love to stick their nose where it doesn't necessarily belong. They own a small shop called 'The Killing Moon' that sells trinkets and oddities, and Eve is also a keen medium who claims they can talk to the dead. Whether that's true or not is up to you, but there's no denying that there's something curious about Eve.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lunarisgames/call-me-under-a-queer-1950s-visual-novel/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
